Specification: This module specifies a simple parametric set-update system with one state variable, `set`, and a constant set `Values`. The system starts with `set = {}` and each step either adds one element from `Values \\ set` to the set or removes one element currently in the set. The comments explain that the model is used as a regression test for set union behavior and checks an invariant stating that the set is not equal to the full set of values, even though the comments note that the full set is reachable in exactly N steps.
